## 提交检查 / Checklist

- [ ] PR 目标分支是 `dev` / This PR targets `dev`.
- [ ] 新功能或 bug 修复包含对应测试 / New features and bug fixes include relevant tests.
- [ ] 已确认没有提交 `.env`、`.data/`、真实聊天记录或任何凭据 / No `.env` files, `.data/` contents, real chat records, or credentials are included.
- [ ] 改动配置向导时，已构建并提交 `backend/xuwen/web_ui/static/` / If the configuration wizard changed, its build output in `backend/xuwen/web_ui/static/` is included.
